headline: Eiger Capital maintains positive long-term view on Eagers Automotive, citing superior management, culture, and compounding track record despite difficult industry economics.
reasoning: Eiger Capital frames Eagers Automotive as a rare outperformer in a structurally challenged industry, delivering ~1800% total return over 16 years — second only to Carvana among their peer set. Key drivers cited include consistent market share growth (organic and via acquisitions), ownership of key retail sites, long-tenured management and culture akin to Mainfreight, and the ability to manage major OEM relationships including new Chinese brands. Eiger acknowledges the business is capital-intensive and compares its next 15-year trajectory to Woolworths' post-peak period (~200% return), while flagging upside from the Canadian expansion (CanadaOne, ~4% market share) and potential disruption in vehicle manufacturing. Key risk is direct OEM sales/service models that could reduce the role of dealership distributors.
quote: So where does Eagers Automotive fit within this very broad range of outcomes? Ignoring Tesla, Eagers Automotive is second over this period to Carvana with a total return of almost 1800%. The outcome seems frankly a bit ridiculous when you consider that Eagers is hardly capital light (it owns many of its retail sites and must fund a large amount of inventory). The next best business in our survey, with significant assets, is BMW with a total return of 275%. A base case could be that Eagers continues on the path from a leading 15% market share and delivers a return similar to Woolworths of 200% over the next 15 years. Equally opportunities in Canada, used cars, the current disruption in vehicle manufacturing and the prospect of much higher share in Australian new cars could see performance significantly higher. Key risk factors could include direct service and sales models that reduce the role of a car distributor. Either way the business track record over the last 16 years suggests an outcome better than the industry outcome.
episode_title: Eagers Automotive – “a riddle wrapped in a mystery inside an enigma^”?
